title: food delivery order path from tap to doorstep

hook.shape: An everyday order shows up sooner than expected, then the story rewinds to the moment it was placed and asks how that was possible.

arc: persona hook with rewind → each stage of the flow walked on one persistent architecture → callback to the opening scene

beats.summary: A delivery arrives faster than the viewer expects, then the story cuts back to the person placing that order.
The placed order becomes a saved record, and a held-open connection flips the restaurant's screen from waiting to accepted.
A closer card shows the order's features grouped and fed into a model, whose guess at cooking time appears where the answer was unknown.
A closer card shows riders in a search ring; the closest is crossed out and one whose travel time fits the cooking time is picked, with a note on the cost.
A single bar splits the promised time into cooking, riding and slack, showing how the pieces add up to the number the user sees.
Raw position pings make the rider hop from point to point, then a smooth line is drawn through them and the rider glides to the door.
The story returns to the opening delivery, now explained, and closes on an invitation to share.

pacing: The hook moves fast: delivery, rewind, the claim, then straight onto the board.
Each closer card opens and closes quickly so the architecture never leaves the screen.
Later stages run shorter, and the final beat holds a little longer for the callback.
